title: Funny Earth Heavy Cotton T-Shirt: Its Nice Being Third Planet Graphic
description:
A funny Earth heavy cotton T-shirt featuring a vivid, full-color planet graphic and the cheeky phrase “IT’S NICE BEING THIRD.” It’s a playful reference to Earth’s place in the solar system and a conversation-starting shirt for astronomy lovers, science teachers, space enthusiasts, and proud residents of the third planet.

The dependable Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton Tee has a comfortable classic fit and medium-weight fabric that works well throughout the year. Its seamless tubular construction creates a clean silhouette, while the ribbed collar and shoulder tape help the shirt maintain its shape.

PRODUCT FEATURES

• Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton T-Shirt
• Classic unisex fit
• Medium-weight 180 g/m² fabric
• Solid colors are 100% cotton
• Tubular knit construction with no side seams
• Ribbed collar for improved shape retention
• Shoulder tape for additional durability
• Tear-away label
• DTG and DTF printing for detailed, colorful artwork
• OEKO-TEX® certified
• Made using ethically sourced US cotton
• Intended for adults
• Made in Nicaragua

FIT AND SIZING

This is a classic-fit T-shirt rather than an oversized or boxy garment. Please compare the product measurements in the listing’s size chart with a shirt you already own before selecting your size.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

• Machine wash cold, maximum 30°C or 90°F
• Use non-chlorine bleach only when needed
• Tumble dry on low heat
• Do not iron
• Do not dry clean

PLEASE NOTE

Every shirt is printed especially for you. Slight variations in color and print placement may occur because of monitor settings, garment sizes, and the made-to-order printing process.

Original concept and creative direction by HomeFromWorking. AI-assisted tools were used during the illustration and refinement process. The finished garment is printed, packaged, and shipped by a disclosed production partner.
